title: a simple life, a simple home - reorganizing my cottage
en: today i felt the need to calm my racing mind sometimes i try to sit and take deep breaths or watch a lighthearted movie but today i woke up and i knew that some healthy escapism was in order in the form of some good books i also decided to let you guys in on my best kept secret and that is that all spare cupboard space in my kitchen is used for storing my many books i decided today it was high time to confess to my potential future identity as a book hoarder and do some reorganizing so so hey tickles

so ne of my favorite movies is called one of my favorite movies is called finding neverland it's a story about the author of peter pan you may be familiar with the story of peter already it's about a magical boy who takes an ordinary girl named wendy and her two brothers to a fantastical place called neverland

where children can be young forever in this world everyone can fly if they're sprinkled with pixie dust i had the pleasure of studying the book when i was a university student in the story there are a group of lost boys who spend their time in neverland going on adventures the part of the story that you may not know if you haven't read the book is that the lost boys chose to come home with wendy when she returns to the real world after a while the lost boys regret leaving neverland and at night their dreams would take them back to that wondrous place to keep them from flying off in their sleep they had to be tied down to the bed over time as they grew into adults they stopped trying to fly and forgot about neverland altogether in many ways the author of peter pan may have wanted us to take a lesson from the characters in this story he sums it up in his favorite quote the moment you doubt whether or not you can fly you can no longer do it i believe the characters show us how dangerous it is to get so wrapped up in the real world that you forget to exercise your imagination or wonder not how things are but how they could be to be able to envision the world you would like to live in and be the change you want to see instead of believing there's no point to thinking that way to spend time dreaming and enjoying all the forms of art that stretch your mind anything from books to movies and music for me i personally find that reading stories inspires me to continue to have a hopeful and positive outlook if you saw my last video you know we endured a heat wave and after it came

many wildfires in my area and shortly after i filmed this video the sky is filled with so much smoke that i was no longer able to see my beloved mountains in the distance the cascades have been blocked out for days now and understandably it filled me with worry in strange times such as these i noticed that there are different approaches to uncertainty about the future one that i find inspiring is people who take action and make practical steps towards improving their world another can be more defeatist that the future isn't something to look forward to or try to change i choose to take an approach directly inspired by the message and the story of peter pan if i choose to lose hope i will no longer be able to see it i will forget about the importance of dreaming and believing in a better tomorrow and letting stories and art and imagination help me visualize it i love my home i believe in the world full of love and that that is what hope has always been the act of loving do

i've included some of my favorite books movies and music in the description bar i thought i'd take a very self-indulgent minute to show you some of the more unusual books in my collection one is this thrifted and stunning copy of dunn's poetry and my most treasured book is this collection of british poetry that i found at a thrift store and was signed and annotated by a man named alan who owned it in 1912 and i found it in as a lover of history i love collecting antique books another favorite is the diary of the edwardian lady i also admit that i have quite a few books that i own because the art inspired me to paint and i have no idea what most of them are about i'll get around to reading them someday do

so do i also have a few treasured books from my childhood including this very worn copy of flower fairy art hank you for indulging my love of thank you for indulging my love of reading today let me know what your favorite book movie or music is wishing you a lovely day or night take that's care you
zh: 今天我觉得需要平静我那急躁的头脑，有时我试着坐下来深呼吸或看一部轻松的电影，但今天我醒来，我知道一些健康的逃避现实是以一些好书的形式出现的，我也决定让你们知道我最保守的秘密，那就是我厨房里所有多余的橱柜空间都用来存放我的许多书我决定今天是时候承认我未来潜在的藏书者身份并做一些重组所以嘿痒痒的
所以我最喜欢的电影之一是我最喜欢的电影之一叫做寻找梦幻岛这是一个关于彼得潘的作者的故事你可能已经熟悉彼得的故事了它是关于一个神奇的男孩带着一个名叫温迪的普通女孩和她的两个兄弟去了一个叫做梦幻岛的奇幻地方

在这个世界上，孩子们可以永远年轻，只要撒上仙尘，每个人都可以飞翔。我还是一名大学生时，有幸读过这本书。故事中有一群迷失的男孩，他们在梦幻岛度过了他们的时光，进行冒险。如果你没有读过这本书，你可能不知道，故事的一部分是，当温蒂回到现实世界时，迷失的男孩们选择了和她一起回家。迷失的男孩们后悔离开了梦幻岛，晚上他们的梦会把他们带回到那个地方。这是一个奇妙的地方，可以防止他们在睡梦中飞走，随着时间的推移，他们必须被绑在床上，随着他们长大成人，他们不再尝试飞翔，在很多方面完全忘记了梦幻岛。《彼得·潘》的作者可能希望我们从这个故事中的人物身上吸取教训，他用他最喜欢的名言来总结这一点，当你怀疑自己是否可以飞的时候，你就不能再飞了。我相信这些人物向我们展示了，沉浸在现实世界中，以至于忘记了发挥想象力，或者不知道如何飞翔，这是多么危险。事情就是这样，但它们如何能够想象你想要生活的世界，成为你想要看到的改变，而不是相信这样思考是没有意义的，花时间做梦，享受各种形式的艺术形式，拓展你的思想，从书籍到电影和音乐，对我来说，我个人发现，阅读故事激励我继续保持充满希望和积极的前景，如果你看了我的上一个视频，你知道我们经历了热浪，之后它来了
我所在地区发生了很多野火，在我拍摄这段视频后不久，天空充满了浓烟，我再也看不到远处我心爱的山脉了，瀑布已经被封锁好几天了，可以理解的是，在这样的奇怪时期，它让我充满了担忧。方法直接受到彼得潘的信息和故事的启发，如果我选择失去希望，我将不再能够看到它，我会忘记梦想和相信更美好明天的重要性，让故事、艺术和想象力帮助我想象它我爱我的家我相信世界充满爱，这就是希望一直是爱的行为

我在描述栏中包含了一些我最喜欢的书籍、电影和音乐，我想我应该花一点时间向您展示我收藏中的一些更不寻常的书籍，其中一本是邓恩诗歌的这本节俭且令人惊叹的副本，我最珍贵的书是我在一家旧货店找到的这本英国诗歌集，由一位名叫艾伦的人签名和注释，他于 1912 年拥有这本书，我是作为一名历史爱好者在我的书中发现的。喜欢收集古董书籍另一个最喜欢的是《爱德华时代女士的日记》我也承认我拥有很多书，因为艺术激发了我绘画的灵感，我不知道其中大部分是关于什么的，有一天我会抽出时间来阅读它们
我也有一些我童年时期珍藏的书籍，包括这本非常破旧的花仙子艺术感谢你包容我的爱感谢你包容我今天对阅读的热爱让我知道你最喜欢的书电影或音乐祝你度过一个美好的白天或夜晚，保重你
